content: Sunita Agarwal from Protect All Agency calls Rohan Deshmukh to confirm receipt of the final policy PDF. Rohan confirms he received it, will sign it tonight, and email it back by 9 PM. Sunita confirms that no additional documents are needed since the deed, utility bill, and fire-safety certificate are already on file. They also discuss online premium payment options (net banking or credit card) via a link to be provided. Sunita states the policy will be activated by tomorrow morning once the signed copy is received.

action_items: Rohan to sign and email back the policy PDF tonight by approximately 9 PM
Sunita to activate the policy by tomorrow morning upon receiving the signed copy
